name: sql
description: Write and reason about portable SQL: joins, aggregation, window functions, CTEs, set operations. Use for .sql files and query questions across engines.
checklist: Joins have correct keys and cardinality
pitfalls: NULL comparison logic (= NULL vs IS NULL)

name: db-postgres
description: Design, query, tune and administer PostgreSQL: types, indexes, EXPLAIN, JSONB, extensions. Use for Postgres connections and .sql on Postgres. Detect psql first.

name: db-mysql
description: Design, query and tune MySQL/MariaDB: storage engines, indexes, EXPLAIN, charsets. Use for MySQL connections. Detect the mysql client first.

name: db-sqlite
description: Use SQLite for embedded/local storage: pragmas, WAL, types, limitations. Use for .db/.sqlite files. Detect sqlite3 first.

name: db-sqlserver
description: Write T-SQL and work with SQL Server: stored procs, indexes, execution plans. Use for T-SQL and SQL Server connections. Detect sqlcmd first.

name: db-oracle
description: Write PL/SQL and work with Oracle: packages, cursors, hints, sequences. Use for PL/SQL and Oracle connections. Detect sqlplus first.
checklist: Cursors closed; bulk operations for volume

name: db-mongodb
description: Model, query and index MongoDB: documents, aggregation pipeline, schema design. Use for MongoDB connections. Detect mongosh first.
checklist: Aggregation stages ordered for efficiency ($match early)

name: db-redis
description: Use Redis for caching, sessions, queues, pub/sub, rate limiting: data types, TTLs, persistence. Use for Redis connections. Detect redis-cli first.
checklist: Right data type for the job
pitfalls: Treating Redis as durable without persistence config

name: db-cassandra
description: Model and query Cassandra/ScyllaDB: partition keys, denormalization, CQL. Use for CQL and Cassandra connections. Detect cqlsh first.

name: db-dynamodb
description: Model DynamoDB with single-table design: partition/sort keys, GSIs, access patterns. Use for DynamoDB. Detect aws cli first.

name: db-elasticsearch
description: Index and search with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch: mappings, analyzers, queries, aggregations. Use for ES/OpenSearch clusters. Detect connectivity first.
pitfalls: Using it as the system of record

name: db-neo4j
description: Model and query graphs with Neo4j/Cypher: nodes, relationships, traversals. Use for Cypher and Neo4j connections. Detect cypher-shell first.

name: db-cockroachdb
description: Use CockroachDB (distributed SQL, Postgres-compatible): ranges, transactions, locality. Use for CockroachDB. Detect cockroach/psql first.
pitfalls: Sequential primary keys creating hot ranges

name: db-clickhouse
description: Use ClickHouse for analytical/OLAP workloads: MergeTree, columnar storage, materialized views. Use for ClickHouse. Detect clickhouse-client first.
checklist: ORDER BY key matches query filters

name: db-duckdb
description: Use DuckDB for fast local analytical SQL over files (Parquet/CSV). Use for .duckdb and analytical queries on files. Detect duckdb first.
checklist: Memory limits set for big files
pitfalls: Loading whole CSVs when Parquet would push down
Ignoring memory limits on large scans

name: db-influxdb
description: Store and query time-series data with InfluxDB: measurements, tags, retention. Use for time-series/metrics storage. Detect influx first.
checklist: Tags vs fields chosen correctly (tags indexed)
pitfalls: Using fields where tags belong (or vice versa)

name: db-migrations
description: Write safe, reversible schema migrations with zero-downtime patterns (expand/contract). Use when changing schemas.
checklist: Migrations reversible or with a tested rollback
Large tables migrated without long locks
pitfalls: Adding a NOT NULL column with no default on a big table (lock)

name: db-indexing
description: Design effective indexes: composite, covering, partial, and when NOT to index. Use when queries are slow or over-indexed.
pitfalls: Wrong column order in composite indexes

name: db-query-optimization
description: Diagnose and fix slow queries using execution plans, indexes and rewrites. Use for slow SQL/queries.
checklist: Execution plan read before changing anything
pitfalls: Guessing instead of reading the plan
Adding indexes without checking the plan uses them

name: db-orm-patterns
description: Use ORMs (Prisma, SQLAlchemy, TypeORM, Hibernate, Eloquent, ActiveRecord) without N+1 and leaky abstractions. Use for ORM code.
checklist: Generated SQL inspected for hot paths
pitfalls: Loading full objects when a projection suffices
Trusting the ORM to be efficient blindly

name: db-backup-restore
description: Plan and perform database backups and restores; verify recoverability. Use for backup/restore and DR tasks.
pitfalls: Never testing the restore (backup that doesn't work)
Secrets/credentials leaking into dumps or logs

name: db-transactions
description: Use transactions and isolation levels correctly: atomicity, locking, deadlocks, retries. Use for multi-step data changes.
checklist: Transactions short to reduce lock contention
pitfalls: Assuming default isolation prevents all anomalies

name: db-nosql-modeling
description: Model NoSQL data by access pattern rather than normalization: denormalization, embedding vs referencing. Use when designing document/key-value/wide-column schemas.
